CREST for Windows (x86-64): licenses of the included components
=================================================================

This crest.exe was built by the brandonbtm29/crest fork (branch qb/windows, workflow
.github/workflows/qb-windows.yml) from upstream crest-lab/crest master plus the Windows
port described in docs/WINDOWS.md, with the MSYS2 UCRT64 MinGW-w64 GCC/gfortran toolchain
and OpenBLAS. It is not an official CREST release.

CREST itself
------------
CREST: LGPL-3.0-or-later (COPYING, COPYING.LESSER next to this file).
Source: https://github.com/crest-lab/crest (fork: https://github.com/brandonbtm29/crest)

Built from source and linked into crest.exe (git submodules of CREST, and the CMake
dependencies tblite fetches at its pinned revisions):
- tblite (https://github.com/tblite/tblite): LGPL-3.0-or-later
- gfnff (https://github.com/pprcht/gfnff): LGPL-3.0-or-later
- gfn0 (https://github.com/pprcht/gfn0): LGPL-3.0-or-later
- lwoniom (https://github.com/crest-lab/lwoniom): LGPL-3.0-or-later
- libpvol (https://github.com/neudecker-group/libpvol): LGPL-3.0-or-later
- toml-f (https://github.com/toml-f/toml-f): Apache-2.0 OR MIT
- mctc-lib (https://github.com/grimme-lab/mctc-lib): Apache-2.0
- multicharge (https://github.com/grimme-lab/multicharge): Apache-2.0
- dftd4 (https://github.com/dftd4/dftd4): LGPL-3.0-or-later
- s-dftd3 (https://github.com/dftd3/simple-dftd3): LGPL-3.0-or-later

Toolchain runtime and libraries (statically linked in the "static" build, DLLs next to
crest.exe in the "shared" build), unmodified from MSYS2 UCRT64 binary packages (exact
versions below). Sources: https://github.com/msys2/MINGW-packages, https://packages.msys2.org/
- libgfortran, libgcc, libgomp (GCC runtime libraries):
  GPL-3.0-or-later WITH GCC-exception-3.1 (GCC Runtime Library Exception).
  https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gcc-exception-3.1.html
- libquadmath (GCC): LGPL-2.1-or-later.
- winpthreads (mingw-w64): MIT AND BSD-3-Clause.
- OpenBLAS (https://github.com/OpenMathLib/OpenBLAS): BSD-3-Clause.

Corresponding source: the fork commit named in the workflow run that produced this file
(CREST plus the qb workflow), the submodule revisions recorded in that commit, the
dependency revisions in subprojects/tblite/config/cmake/Find*.cmake, and the MSYS2 package
sources above. The workflow rebuilds crest.exe from them.
